title: 변호사ㆍ법무사의 자격이 있는 보증인의 보수에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 변호사ㆍ법무사의 자격이 있는 보증인의 보수에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Standards for Remuneration)
The remuneration of a guarantor qualified as an attorney-at-law or certified judicial scrivener under Article 11 (2) 2 of the Special Act on Registration of Transfer of Real Estate Ownership, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") (hereinafter referred to as a "qualified guarantor") shall be determined by agreement between the person seeking issuance of a confirmation under Article 11 (1) of the Act and the qualified guarantor, within a limit not exceeding 4.5 million won. Provided, however, that the remuneration may be increased by an amount not exceeding 25 percent of 4.5 million won, taking into consideration the following matters:
1. The complexity of the facts and legal issues;
2. The degree of effort required to verify the facts concerning the content of the guarantee.
